problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2y+5x=3z+2 \\ 3x-6y=5 \\ 2x-3y+5z=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & a & -3 \\ 3 & -6 & b \\ 2 & c & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}5x+2y-3z=2 \\ 3x-6y+0z=5 \\ 2x-3y+5z=-1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -3 \\ 3 & -6 & 0 \\ 2 & -3 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & 2 & -3 \\ 3 & -6 & 0 \\ 2 & -3 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=2,\,b=0,\,c=-3.$
